verdict.rationale: a-Shell does have programmatic surfaces (Shortcuts actions and an optional relay HTTPS server with POST /run), so an API reference is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence says the relay endpoint is described only in README prose and that there is no interactive reference, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404. The in-app `help` command only lists available shell commands, which is an adjacent feature and not an interactive API reference with runnable examples.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
